scope: Replace beta soundtrack only after audio is generated and checked. Preserve independent music and SFX controls, saved volume, crossfades and background pause.
shared_direction: Original instrumental game score. No vocals, spoken words, recognizable existing melodies, abrupt endings or harsh clipping. Clear melodic identity, spacious mix beneath game sound effects. Seamless loop with matching harmony and pulse at the boundary. Aim for 60–90 seconds with an opening motif, variation and return; menu and battle versions share a motif but have distinct arrangements.

menu.title: After Dark, Before the Crown
menu.prompt: Nocturnal instrumental hip-hop with warm electric piano, dusty restrained drums, rounded bass and a short wistful brass motif. Rain-soaked illustrated city streets and amber shop windows. Relaxed, thoughtful menu and travel loop.

battle.title: King of the Block
battle.prompt: Energetic instrumental boom-bap battle score with punchy drums, syncopated bass, chopped original brass phrases and rhythmic keys. Reprise the menu motif with greater urgency. Confident street-chess tension, not frantic; leave room for game effects.

menu.title: Lanterns on the Ramparts
menu.prompt: Medieval-inspired fantasy instrumental: plucked lute, warm low strings, wooden flute and sparse frame drum. Torchlit stone bridges and distant mountain fortresses. Noble, restrained melody, contemplative travel loop.

battle.title: Iron Oath
battle.prompt: Medieval fantasy battle instrumental: driving frame drums, low string ostinato, restrained horns and lute accents. Transform the menu motif into a determined marching theme. Weight and resolve rather than constant cinematic crashes.

menu.title: Olive and Marble
menu.prompt: Luminous ancient-Greek-inspired fantasy instrumental with delicate lyre-like plucks, airy reed flute, warm strings and light hand percussion. Marble courts and sunlit Aegean skies. Graceful, spacious melody for menus and travel.

battle.title: Trial Beneath the Gods
battle.prompt: Rhythmic heroic fantasy battle music with quick lyre arpeggios, hand drums, bronze-like percussion, strings and restrained brass. Develop the menu motif into an agile, proud challenge theme. Bright clarity without overpowering gameplay.

menu.title: Between Broken Stars
menu.prompt: Dreamlike fantasy ambient instrumental with glassy plucks, soft evolving synth pads, bowed textures and subtle irregular echoes. Floating ruins and a fractured moon. An original haunting motif, beautiful and uneasy, seamless contemplative loop.

battle.title: Across the Rift
battle.prompt: Mystical electronic-orchestral battle instrumental with interlocking glass arpeggios, pulsing low synth, crisp restrained percussion and shimmering strings. Return to the menu motif in a tense, fractured rhythmic setting. Clear beat, no overwhelming distortion.

menu.title: Ashes Remember
menu.prompt: Dark regal fantasy instrumental with low strings, muted piano, distant organ and sparse resonant metallic tones. An abandoned obsidian throne hall, ash and embers. Solemn, spacious, foreboding original motif; instrumental only.

battle.title: The Last Procession
battle.prompt: Dark epic battle instrumental with measured war drums, low string ostinato, restrained organ and ominous brass. Develop the menu motif into relentless resolve. Strong dynamics but no giant impacts or vocals; loop under tactical combat.

additional_tracks.title: The Road to a Crown
additional_tracks.prompt: Original instrumental title theme unifying a short rising crown motif with warm piano, plucked strings, subtle electronic texture and restrained orchestral percussion. Begin inviting and mysterious, develop into quiet determination. 80 BPM, seamlessly looping, no vocals.

additional_tracks.title: No King Above the Ashes
additional_tracks.prompt: Original final-boss instrumental developed from the Fallen Throne motif. Low organ, urgent strings, controlled war drums and stark brass responses. 116 BPM. Menacing opening, determined middle, return to opening harmony for seamless looping. No vocals, excessive crashes or abrupt ending.

integration.land_battle: per-Land battle track, distinct from menu

Check transitions between menu, travel, shop and battle
Check music toggle and volume on mobile
Publish to Crownfallbeta and verify GitHub Pages
